notes.title: 1.6 Update Now Available
notes.content:
It's been quite a few years since this version of Containment Initiative has received an update, so I figured it was long overdue to get some of the content that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/527700/Containment_Initiative/]VR original[/url] received over the past 4 years. I plan on having at least one more major update in the coming month or two where I bring over the two additional missions that are missing from this version: Checkpoint and Sewers.

Features:

[h2]New Muzzle Flash Effects[/h2] - A big improvement has been made to the muzzle flash effects when firing weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556747/13d44b5e2a8c624449a6eecf86b9abd8ad53e932.gif[/img]

[h2]Visual Redesigns[/h2] - New lighting, fog, and architecture has been added to the Bridge and Midtown maps.

New Bridge Map:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556747/e263e56f4a7a156031fdcde5ccb6b39b33c829ff.png[/img]

Old Bridge Map:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556747/571ece706165f595eb75280005ef9a1e0b50ef1e.png[/img]



[h2]Weapon Handling Improvements[/h2] - In an effort to make the weapons feel more satisfying to use, their fire rate has been increased and their reload speed quickened.

[h2]New Ability: Aim down sights[/h2] - The player can now use the right mouse button/left trigger to aim down the sights to shoot distant enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556747/b9e8d4f95d347f00adf5f20b5962756225fc0ae4.gif[/img]

[h2]Optimization[/h2] - Performance optimizations have been made across all maps.

[h2]Menu Redesigns[/h2] - The menu is now more readable and has a more modern design.

Old Menu:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556747/1121109f0ca7e41bb1e58851f7fcd5307af84a19.png[/img]

New Menu:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556747/e5a27397f60e08a7780b312eeeef92cca0e6fef4.png[/img]

[h2]Explosive Canisters[/h2] - Explosive canisters now spawn in some levels

[h2]Improved Reload Animations[/h2] - Pistols now have improved animations when there is no round chambered.

[h2]New Post Processing Effects[/h2] - Improved image quality with Depth of Field, Color Correction, and Bloom

[h2]Weapon Audio Overhaul[/h2] - Each weapon now has multiple firing sounds that it can emit. It really adds a lot more realism to the game. The new audio is professionally recorded and ended up being miles better than what was currently in the game.

[h2]New Enemy: Armored Zombie[/h2] - His armor plating makes him a very tough target to take out. His body armor prevents you from knocking him back as well. In addition to the armor, some carry smoke grenades on their shoulders. If you accidentally hit the smoke grenade, it will set off and spray smoke everywhere

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556747/ae4a7ef5664f19d20c8a75420f1d5426616bfead.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2] - 10 achievements have been added to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556747/30b8e6ae4c8ebb2f680a9b5d71fe86acf92eff6e.png[/img]

notes.title: Containment Initiative: PC Standalone 1.5 Released
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]

[b]Split-Screen Co-op[/b]
You can now use the keyboard/mouse along with an Xbox controller to play in split-screen local co-op with another person on the same computer. Currently available maps are Factory and City Scavenge. This feature is still experimental. Please leave any feedback on the forums.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32556747/76c2791d1947623c5005100dbf407646f6be2230.gif[/img]

[b]New Weapons[/b]
.45 Pistol: Strong single bullet damage with a lower ammo capacity.
7.62 Rifle: Higher damage potential than any other rifle. Large magazine capacity and quick follow up shots mean you can dish out serious damage.

[b]New Loot Drop System[/b]
In scavenge levels, all enemies have a chance to drop items now. These items include money, ammo for the PC player, and rare upgrades and skins.

[b]Blood improvements[/b]
The blood reaction that a zombie produces when they are shot has been vastly improved. The blood will now eject towards where the bullet was shot from and also has a mist effect that accompanies the blood spurts. Zombie parts and blood drips will now leave blood that pools on the ground.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32556747/90b0f533e097278481202c5c2ff6d0e97e100608.gif[/img]

[b]Zombie Deformation[/b]
Zombies can now have their legs/arms blown or cut off.

[b]New Weapon Stat Mods[/b]
Double stack magazines and different types of ammo that either buff damage to zombies or mutants are possible drops from the loot system.

[b]City Scavenge Redesign[/b]
The City: Scavenge map has undergone a fairly massive redesign. All environmental assets have been replaced with completely new, higher quality versions. The layout has undergone a few minor changes, but is largely the same.
